## Context: 
Project Title: Multimodal Data Processing System
Objective: Build a system capable of processing multimodal input files and
responding to natural language queries.

Input File Types:
Text: pdf, docx, pptx,
md, txt
Image: png, jpg
Audio/Video: mp3,
mp4, YouTube

## Task Description:
Process and extract data from input files
Accept user queries in natural language
Search the knowledge base to provide a natural
language answer
Database: Developer’s choice
LLM: Gemini (Free version)
UI (Optional): HTML / Streamlit / Command Line

## Reference:
We can think this as a notebook llm clone.

## Tech stack:
Python for backend
html and css for UI
